comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Root cause was converting to UTC before applying workspace zone. Flipping the order; re-running the suite.

content.text: Root cause was converting to UTC before applying workspace zone. Flipping the order; re-running the suite.

Dashboard date range pickers call three different timezone helpers: one in reports, one in activity, and a copy-pasted function in the board filter bar. They disagree on DST boundaries, so a 'last 7 days' range can shift by an hour depending on which widget you open.

Consolidate on toWorkspaceRange(start, end, workspaceTz) in @nimbus/time, delete the local helpers, and make every dashboard date control go through that API. Unit coverage must include America/Santiago spring-forward and Europe/Paris fall-back for March/October 2025.

description_text:
Dashboard date range pickers call three different timezone helpers: one in reports, one in activity, and a copy-pasted function in the board filter bar. They disagree on DST boundaries, so a 'last 7 days' range can shift by an hour depending on which widget you open.
Consolidate on toWorkspaceRange(start, end, workspaceTz) in @nimbus/time, delete the local helpers, and make every dashboard date control go through that API. Unit coverage must include America/Santiago spring-forward and Europe/Paris fall-back for March/October 2025.
